title: Year file (dist/json/<cc>/<year>.json)
description: All holidays of one country in one year, computed from the rules. Both runtimes return exactly this document from year().

format.description: Format version of this document. Additive changes keep the number.

holidays.description: Sorted by date, then by the order of the holidays in the data file.

name.description: Names keyed by BCP 47 language tag; always has en.

startTime.description: null = whole day; otherwise the local time (HH:MM) from which the day is off.

substituteFor.description: null, or the original date (YYYY-MM-DD) this substitute day replaces.

nationwide.description: true: applies in the whole country; regions is then empty.

regions.description: ISO 3166-2 codes where this entry applies, when not nationwide.

sources.description: Ids into the sources object of this document.
The sources cited by the entries above.
